base.$description: Focus ring color for mouse/pointer focus on interactive badges. Uses accent-300 for brand-aligned focus indication. Theme-dependent.

accessible.$description: Focus ring color for keyboard focus (focus-visible) on interactive badges. Uses accent-300 for brand-aligned focus indication. Theme-dependent.

base.$description: Focus ring width for mouse/pointer focus on interactive badges. References global focus ring width.

accessible.$description: Focus ring width for keyboard focus (focus-visible) on interactive badges. References global accessible focus ring width (3px).

offset.$description: Space between badge border and focus ring. Creates visual separation for better clarity.
